label: ercot215 arm decontam
definition: ercot-215 armed: keeper recipe + ercot_ordc_adder_family_counterpart (the ercot-214 counterpart decontamination — gamma' = min(gamma_all, gamma_ordc_family) inside the armed published-anchor branch; PRECOMMIT-ercot215-counterpart-decontamination-2026-08-17.md §1)
market_story: This keeper moves NO generation: the delta is post-solve price decontamination, and every dispatch sidecar is byte-identical to the prior keeper's (G-EXACT). The market story is about the written RT price: 2023-25 ERCOT settles RTSPP = RTLMP + RTORPA + RTORDPA, where RTORPA is the ORDC on realized TOTAL online reserves — there is no real-time per-product scarcity price, and a product-vs-capability squeeze triggers RUC commitment instead. The prior keeper's additive adder read the all-tier cap dual, which carries the model's AS-product shortfall-ramp steps ($416.67 quanta) on top of the ORDC component; those steps are DAM-plan withholding scaffolding, not a price the market emits. This keeper writes the ORDC component alone (the ercot_ordc_total family's own dual, the series that tracks published settled RTORPA in both regimes), so scarcity hours are priced the way ERCOT actually prices them, and the June-2023 mid-band spill hours (published RTORPA $0.11-$1.32, actual RT < $150) no longer carry a ~$412 phantom adder.
